content_data.meeting_title: Weekly Sales Performance Review & Compliance Update
agenda_items: Key Client Engagement Strategies for Upcoming Period
key_decisions: Implement new compliance checklist for all international content licensing agreements, effective immediately.
Allocate additional resources to support the EMEA sales team's efforts in securing two major advertising contracts.
action_items: Regional Managers: Prepare Q4 client retention strategies for review by the end of the current period.
Sales Manager (Self): Follow up with Head of Legal regarding the new contractual language for digital rights within the next 3 business days.
Sales Enablement: Develop and schedule a training module on advanced negotiation tactics within the next month.
